stage.input: ds003138 case02; current qualified CPU CNN's final decoder skip and nearest source
stage.values: all FP32 bits equal to baseline including signed zero and nonfinite unit contracts
stage.layout: shape, dtype, contiguous NCDHW strides and skip-first channel order exact
stage.performance: report both ABBA process arms and all per-process operation times; candidate median operation <= baseline median is the stage speed target
stage.memory: report actual per-process maximum RSS and GNU time; no inferred whole-model budget pass

full_cpu.scope: ordinary 33-class, non-fast parc and fast parc; current original-T1 preprocessing
full_cpu.hard_labels: saved arrays exact to current qualified FNIT
full_cpu.geometry: shape affine zoom dtype qform sform exact
full_cpu.csv: same columns; rtol=1e-5 and atol=0.01 mm3
full_cpu.official: report all per-label errors and soft-volume differences; count errors introduced, removed and retained

gpu.implementation: retain original interpolate and cat CUDA route, convolution/backend/precision unchanged
gpu.acceptance: actual same-input old/new outputs and target GPU time/memory remain necessary before adopting production

remaining: stage is not a complete neural network or a general CPU speedup benchmark; robust SynthSeg+ is not implemented
